name: EPIC 205965619
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 12.7 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205965619 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.689742 (16th-84th percentiles 12.492159-12.942207), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205965619 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.81081 (16th-84th percentiles 0.792157-0.847214), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205965619: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4492.0938 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205965619 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1398.398438 (16th-84th percentiles 1379.804688-1418.90625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,398 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.81 solar masses and 12.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,492 K at its surface.
